verdict.rationale: Aircall ships AI Agents and AI Assistants, so asking whether it can act as an MCP client and use tools from plugged-in MCP servers is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP. The cited agent actions (Shopify, Stripe, calendar, CRM) are vendor integrations, an adjacent feature that earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
